uncertainty_quantification_audit.exact_mathematical_definition: Posterior standard deviation of latent player skill parameter under conjugate normal model
empirical_bayes_assumptions: Hyperparameter tau2_player estimated from historical population and plugged into conjugate Gaussian model
Prior mean variance sigma2_mu_LPMO folded into total prior variance tau2_total = tau2_player + sigma2_mu_LPMO
Observation variance V incorporates within-spell binomial/normal variance and match-level HHI concentration (H * sigma2_match)
Conditional on plug-in hyperparameters, latent skill posterior is Gaussian: theta_i | Y ~ N(shrunk_estimate, latent_se^2)
uncertainty_quantification_audit.terminology_verdict: Credible-bound terminology is confirmed mathematically; 1.645 represents a one-sided 95% credible bound (and endpoint of a central 90% credible interval).
